description: Registry of scientific journal publisher domains, anti-bot policies, WAF defenses, and safe API alternatives for autonomous agents.

publishers.name: American Chemical Society (ACS)
publishers.reason: Deploys Cloudflare Turnstile and AI Crawl Control to block programmatic scrapers, curl, and automated agents. Strict prohibition of unauthorized text and data mining.
publishers.recommended_api: Crossref TDM API (with institutional token), OpenAlex metadata & abstract, Unpaywall institutional repository copies.

publishers.name: American Physical Society (APS)
publishers.reason: Blocks bots with 403 Forbidden. Robots.txt explicitly disallows AI scrapers (Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot). Direct PDF links on link.aps.org will fail.
publishers.recommended_api: APS Physical Review REST API (token required), arXiv preprints, OpenAlex.

publishers.name: Elsevier / ScienceDirect
publishers.reason: Active legal enforcement and Cloudflare AI Crawl Control. Even robots.txt is blocked with 403 Forbidden to non-browser requests.
publishers.recommended_api: Elsevier ScienceDirect Interactive API (https://api.elsevier.com/content/article/doi/{doi}) with API key and Institutional Token.

publishers.name: Springer Nature / Nature Portfolio
publishers.reason: Returns interstitial JavaScript challenge stubs (3KB HTML) instead of true content for scrapers. Direct PDF access requires authentication or is blocked.
publishers.recommended_api: Springer Nature TDM API (https://spdi.public.springernature.app/xmldata/jats) and Meta API (https://api.springernature.com/meta/v2/json).

publishers.name: Wiley Online Library
publishers.reason: Cloudflare challenge blocks direct paper landing page and PDF retrieval. Automated data harvesting violates Wiley terms of use.
publishers.recommended_api: Wiley TDM service via Crossref Click-Through Service, or OpenAlex / Unpaywall green OA repositories.

publishers.name: Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC)
publishers.reason: Direct requests receive 403 Forbidden via Cloudflare Turnstile challenge.
publishers.recommended_api: Europe PMC for open access chemistry papers, OpenAlex for metadata/abstracts, Unpaywall for repository preprints.

publishers.name: IOP Publishing (Institute of Physics)
publishers.reason: Redirects programmatic requests to validate.perfdrive.com with interactive CAPTCHA, preventing programmatic retrieval.
publishers.recommended_api: Crossref metadata, arXiv preprints, OpenAlex, Unpaywall institutional repository copies.

publishers.name: AIP Publishing (American Institute of Physics)
publishers.reason: Cloudflare Turnstile blocks automated requests with 403 Forbidden.
publishers.recommended_api: Crossref metadata, arXiv preprints, OpenAlex.

publishers.name: IEEE Xplore
publishers.reason: Returns HTTP 202 with empty body or JavaScript challenge. Aggressively blacklists IPs caught scraping paper metadata or PDFs.
publishers.recommended_api: IEEE Xplore REST API (https://developer.ieee.org/) with API key.

publishers.name: AAAS / Science
publishers.reason: Blocks bots with Cloudflare challenge (403 Forbidden).
publishers.recommended_api: PubMed Central / Europe PMC (for NIH/public funded papers), OpenAlex.

publishers.name: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS)
publishers.reason: Cloudflare Turnstile blocks direct scraper access.
publishers.recommended_api: PubMed Central / Europe PMC (all PNAS papers deposited after 6 months), OpenAlex.

publishers.name: Taylor & Francis Online
publishers.reason: Blocks automated web scraping with 403 Forbidden.
publishers.recommended_api: Crossref TDM, OpenAlex, Unpaywall.

publishers.name: Oxford University Press (OUP)
publishers.reason: Cloudflare challenge prevents programmatic agent access.
publishers.recommended_api: Europe PMC, OpenAlex, Unpaywall.

publishers.name: Cambridge University Press (CUP)
publishers.reason: Heavy rate limits and Cloudflare challenge on repeated article requests.
publishers.recommended_api: Crossref, OpenAlex, Unpaywall.

publishers.name: MDPI
publishers.reason: Returns 403 Access Denied to default programmatic requests (curl, requests).
publishers.recommended_api: OpenAlex, MDPI OpenAPI / Crossref metadata, PMC repository links.

publishers.name: ChemRxiv (Cambridge Open Engage)
publishers.reason: Frontend web browsing pages are protected by Cloudflare Turnstile (403 on direct scraping). Must use official public REST API.
publishers.recommended_api: ChemRxiv Public API (https://chemrxiv.org/engage/chemrxiv/public-api/v1/items), Crossref.

publishers.name: bioRxiv / medRxiv (CSHL)
publishers.reason: Direct web and PDF requests trigger 429 Too Many Requests. Bulk scraping web pages is prohibited.
publishers.recommended_api: bioRxiv API (https://api.biorxiv.org/details/biorxiv/{interval}), CSHL Amazon S3 public bucket.

publishers.name: arXiv
publishers.reason: Requires minimum 3 seconds between requests (Crawl-delay: 15s in robots.txt). High-frequency automated PDF scraping triggers automatic IP bans.
publishers.recommended_api: Official arXiv API (http://export.arxiv.org/api/query) or Amazon S3 bulk bucket (s3://arxiv).

publishers.name: Public Library of Science (PLOS)
publishers.reason: Open access, but enforces a strict Crawl-delay of 30 seconds for web crawlers.
publishers.recommended_api: PLOS Search API (https://api.plos.org/search), PubMed Central.

publishers.name: Frontiers
publishers.reason: Rate limits automated clients; requires compliant headers or Europe PMC fallback.
publishers.recommended_api: Europe PMC, OpenAlex, Frontiers REST endpoints.

safe_open_access_providers.name: OpenAlex
safe_open_access_providers.description: Comprehensive open bibliographic database with reconstructed abstracts, citations, and verified repository OA links.

safe_open_access_providers.name: Unpaywall
safe_open_access_providers.description: Finds legal open-access full text copies hosted in institutional and disciplinary repositories. Must filter out publisher direct links.

safe_open_access_providers.name: Europe PMC
safe_open_access_providers.description: Direct full-text XML and PDF access for open-access life sciences and chemistry literature.

safe_open_access_providers.name: Crossref Works API
safe_open_access_providers.description: Official DOI registry metadata and license/TDM links.
